summary: VinFast Auto Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing preliminary domestic Vietnam deliveries of 19,503 EVs for May 2026, bringing year-to-date deliveries to 97,961 vehicles. The filing is a routine operational update, not a special situation. It includes model-by-model breakdowns and notes that results are preliminary and subject to audit. No transaction, structural change, or extraordinary corporate event is described. The report is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. This is a routine voluntary disclosure of monthly sales metrics, equivalent to a US issuer's press release on operational data.
